title: Basketball
description: Test your knowledge of hoops, dunks, and the NBA!

questions.question: Who is the all-time leading scorer in NBA history?
questions.explanation: LeBron James passed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's record in February 2023.

questions.question: How many championships did Michael Jordan win with the Chicago Bulls?
questions.explanation: Jordan won 6 NBA Finals (1991, 1992, 1993, 1996, 1997, 1998), going undefeated.

questions.question: A three-point shot is worth three points only if taken from beyond the arc.
questions.explanation: Any shot made from behind the three-point line counts as three points.

questions.question: How many players from each team are on the court during play?
questions.explanation: Each NBA team has 5 players on the court at any time.

questions.question: Which player is known as 'The Black Mamba'?
questions.explanation: Kobe Bryant adopted the 'Black Mamba' nickname for his fierce mentality.

questions.question: The NBA was founded in 1946 as the BAA.
questions.explanation: The Basketball Association of America (BAA) was founded in 1946 and became the NBA in 1949.

questions.question: Which team has won the most NBA championships?
questions.explanation: The Boston Celtics have 18 championships, edging out the Lakers' 17.

questions.question: Who scored 100 points in a single NBA game?
questions.explanation: Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors on March 2, 1962.

questions.question: What is a triple-double in basketball?

options.text: Double digits in three statistical categories

questions.explanation: A triple-double means reaching double digits (10+) in three of: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks.

questions.question: The shot clock in the NBA is 24 seconds.
questions.explanation: Teams must attempt a shot that hits the rim within 24 seconds of gaining possession.
